clips.title: The story
paras: High Priestess Laurena is a respected human priest trainer stationed behind the grand altar within Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. She instructs budding Alliance priests in spiritual devotion and arcane wards.

As a High Priestess of the Church of the Holy Light, Laurena holds one of the senior posts within the towering halls of the Cathedral of Light, the heart of the faith in Stormwind City, where Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church.
